In fervent fervor, I fervently pray,
That fervent flames of fervor may sway,
Your fervent heart, where fervent fire burns,
And fervent fervor's fervent yearnings learns.

I don't want to set, the world on fire's blaze,
That fervent fervor may in fervent ways,
 Ignite a spark, a flame that's true and bright,
In fervent fervor's fervent, fervent light.

I just want to start, a flame in your heart's core,
A fervent fervor that forever will roar,
A fervent fervor that in fervent zeal will burn,
And fervent fervor's fervent fervor will yearn.
